history.plan: 18_displacement: do NOT take the page top for the 16 solo-18 documents - all 16 are single-page PDFs and their converted .docx carries zero page breaks, so the proven page-top construct cannot make one of them clean. Their displacement is row/line pitch inside one dense table or form: start from the -4.3 median / -12.8..+2.9 spread measured on page 1 of bank-statement-5-pages, which is the residual after the page-top fix and sits on a page that was never broken. Land the section margin (w:pgMar w:top) as a SEPARATE build on multi-page documents: DocxWriter.java:1053-1075 already emits a sectPr with nextPage, so it is that path plus beforeTw=0 in the two ctx.newPage branches (3395-3401, 4277-4283) plus the same twips out of ctx.budgetTw (1116) and out of what pageFits is asked - steps 1-2 alone double the gap in LibreOffice, step 3 is what holds the page count. Do NOT retry the 1x1 trHeight row: measured this run, it takes bank-statement-5-pages from 5 pages to 6 and 37/42 to 33/42.

context: 18_displacement: the trHeight-absorb construct (trHeight=pitch-20tw + tcMar bottom) was applied, built and measured in Google on 2 documents - tnhr 46/47->46/47, mobile-bill 46/47->46/47, same check, nothing clean. Independent PyMuPDF geometry: the patch halves the drift ramp (16.25->8.38 pt, table span 495->482 vs source 478) but the first line of the block sits at -10.16 pt in BOTH renders and mobile-bill at -15.75, so the residual 18_displacement is a per-document TOP-OF-BLOCK OFFSET that no row construct can touch. LO cost of the patch confirmed by two agents (30-36 share@5 on four documents). Reverted, no engine change landed.
